result:
Review complete. **Verdict: approve (tier1)**, written to `review-verdict.json`.

Summary: the middleware fix (`/site-materials` added to `PROTECTED_PREFIXES`) correctly closes the prior audit's blocking issue — the page now redirects unauthenticated users to `/login` instead of bypassing auth. The rest of the diff is additive proxy routes and one UI screen, all faithfully following the existing `requireAuth()` + `callVeridian(..., {root:true})` pattern with no schema/auth/RLS changes, consistent with tier1.

One real bug found: `/api/schedule-tracker/import` passes a `FormData` body into `callVeridianRaw()`, which `JSON.stringify()`s it (producing `"{}"`) and forces a JSON content-type — the multipart upload is silently broken. It's currently dead code (no UI calls it yet per PROGRESS.md), so no active impact, but flagged as a follow-up to fix before the Schedule Tracker screen ships.
